verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt file at https://docs.usestable.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, structured "# Stable Documentation" header), so an agent can be pointed at it directly. The docs are also served as raw markdown pages (e.g., /docs/getting-started.md, /docs/webhooks.md, /reference/authentication.md), which suits agent ingestion. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing agent/LLM usage of the docs, evidence of llms-full.txt or full-content coverage, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
